description: A tiny 8-case reasoning benchmark — the small/quick demo. Case 'case-007' can simulate a provider 503 by setting simulate_503 to true below. Use this when the user asks for 'the small demo' or 'the quick eval'.

cases.prompt: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many sheep are left? Answer with just the number and one sentence of reasoning.
Which is heavier: a kilogram of steel or a kilogram of feathers? Explain in two sentences.
If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how long does it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
Reverse the word 'gateway' and state whether the result is a palindrome.
I have a 3-liter jug and a 5-liter jug. How do I measure exactly 4 liters? List the steps briefly.
What day of the week is 100 days after a Monday? Show the arithmetic.
Name the odd one out: apple, banana, carrot, mango. Justify in one sentence.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much is the ball?
